# Ntombii Tech

> Newcastle-born digital studio designing and building mobile-first websites, web apps and brand systems for businesses across Northern KZN and the rest of Africa.

Ntombii Tech is an independent product studio based in Newcastle, KwaZulu-Natal. We work with founders, schools, NGOs and growing local brands on UI/UX design, web development, brand strategy and local SEO — fast, focused and AI-assisted, with pricing from R2,500.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Studio overview, featured work, services and testimonials.
- [Services](/services): UI/UX, web development, mobile design and brand systems.
- [Work](/work): Selected client projects across NGOs, events, education and local business.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Transparent packages for websites, branding and ongoing support.
- [About](/about): Who we are, how we work and where we're based.
- [Blog](/blog): Local SEO, web design and digital strategy for South African businesses.
- [Contact](/contact): Start a project or get a quote.
- [Areas](/areas): Towns and townships across Northern KZN we serve.

## Locations

- [Newcastle](/areas/newcastle): Web design and local SEO in Newcastle, KZN.
- [Madadeni](/areas/madadeni): Websites and branding for Madadeni businesses.
- [Vryheid](/areas/vryheid): Web design for Vryheid and surrounding farms and towns.
- [Ladysmith](/areas/ladysmith): Websites and branding for Ladysmith businesses.
- [Dundee](/areas/dundee): Web design and SEO for Dundee, KZN.
- [Utrecht](/areas/utrecht): Websites for Utrecht businesses.
